audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill/Teemo/Teemo/Skill/Skill/Teemo/Teemo. Level 2 was given to Teemo although whys[1] calls it 'my single best window to chunk him', and Levels 4-5 and 6 were called Skill although whys[3] says he 'out-trades my whole double-shot pattern' and whys[4] says '6 doesn't give me the lane back'.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill, Lucian, Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Teemo) matches the prose exactly and matches the 37.5% win rate — Lucian gets exactly one stage, the Level 2 window before Blinding Dart exists.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side -> Lucian; win[3], win[4] and their phases -> Teemo, with ratings adjusted.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly owned: Lvl 2 Lucian's only window, Lvl 3 blind plus kite, Lvl 6 The Culling not shifting the lane, 1st item Blackfire/Liandry's. Matches the corrected chart.

This page already states the interaction correctly — 'a blinded Lightslinger does almost nothing', 'his Q blind comes online and negates my Lightslinger autos'. That is right: Lightslinger makes his NEXT ATTACK a double-shot, and blind removes attacks. The mirror flagged the opposite error on Teemo's own page (it asserted four times that the double-shot fires through blind); nothing to correct on this side, so I did not touch the framing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ardent Blaze reveals, and nothing on the page connects that to Guerrilla Warfare.
audit.why: Lucian's W: 'marking and briefly revealing enemies', and it carries the revealsStealth flag at 900 range. Teemo's passive: 'If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving.' So the one tool in Lucian's kit that answers a camoed Teemo sitting in the tri-brush is his W, and the page currently only sells W as a move-speed steroid. This is the most useful unstated interaction here.

audit.whatIsWrong: Move Quick's passive speed is treated as permanent kiting ('kites back on his passive move speed'), and its off-switch is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret.' One landed hit strips the passive component — so the first shot of a trade is what makes the rest of it possible, and a Teemo who has not been touched is the one you cannot catch. 14s cooldown on the active.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no number for the matchup-defining ability and told you to 'trade with spells while it is up' without saying why that fails.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a FLAT 7 seconds at every rank, 680 range — it never gets shorter and it never gets longer, and 680 out-ranges Piercing Light's 500. Trading 'with spells' does not work because casting the spell is what loads the double-shot he is about to delete: the sequencing is cast AFTER the dart is spent, not before.
audit.corrected: Flat 7s, the range, and the cast-after-the-dart sequencing written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization is the generic Lucian line with nothing about Toxic Shot.
audit.why: Toxic Shot is an on-hit poison with no cooldown that ticks for 4 seconds after impact, so his damage scales with attack speed and time-on-target rather than raw hits. Reading the trade off armour alone misprices it — the flagged missing interaction for this matchup.

edits.before: Passive double-shots win level 1 outright — Q through the wave on his last-hits and weave doubletaps on every step-up.
edits.after: Neither of you has a real Level 1 — last-hit and set up Level 2, because Blinding Dart is a flat 7s once he has it.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Blinding Dart — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Blinding Dart's flat 7s comes up more often than your windows, and Toxic Shot poisons every auto he lands on you.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Blind the lead-in and The Culling is a damage tick — shrooms wall the angle you needed to close.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: His first item turns the poison-and-blind war lethal against your low base HP long before Lightslinger answers.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: Shrooms and splitpush out-scale a weak ADC scaler — group and use The Culling where he cannot kite one target.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds your autos — trade with spells while it is up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart: a flat 7s at every rank, 680 range — it deletes the Lightslinger double-shot, because that is a basic attack. Cast your ability only after the dart is spent. - Your E dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: Blinds your autos — trade with spells while it is up. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s — it kills the double-shot, so cast your ability only after he spends it.

edits.before: Teemo burns Blinding Dart on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Move Quick's passive speed drops the moment any hit lands — one auto slows him.

edits.before: Track Teemo’s Blinding Dart: Blinds your autos — trade with spells while it is up. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Ardent Blaze marks and reveals — his brush camo breaks the moment your W lands on him from 900 range.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. First: Kraken Slayer or Essence Reaver into Berserker's Greaves; then Navori / The Collector by lane state.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Toxic Shot is on-hit and keeps ticking for 4s, so armour alone misreads the trade — value HP and sustain early.

notes: The mirror's top-priority finding was an error on Teemo's own page, not this one — this entry already says correctly that blind kills the Lightslinger double-shot, so I left that framing intact and spent the budget on the flat-7s number, the Ardent Blaze reveal, and the Move Quick off-switch. Toxic Shot's damage type is not stated in Riot's text, so I wrote 'on-hit' and 'ticks for 4s' and did not claim magic damage or recommend MR. Noxious Trap is 0.25s cooldown at 600/750/900 range with mushroom-bounce chaining — real but it is a charge-limited ability and the kit file gives no charge count, so I did not write anything implying he can spam them.
